Style: Preset look: porcelain (glazed white), bone (warm matte), marble (white with veins), nero (black marble). Sets base and vein colour, roughness, glaze and subsurface tint.
Tint: Colour multiplier on the preset base colour. White = unchanged.
Veintint: Colour multiplier on the preset vein colour. White = unchanged.
Gloss: 0 = matte, 1 = glazed; controls clear-coat strength and roughness.
Sss: Width of the fake subsurface wrap lighting and warm terminator band; also thin-edge translucency. 0 = hard shading.
Thickness: How much translucency varies with a noise thickness. 0 = uniform, higher = patchy glow.
Veinamount: Intensity of the marble veins. 0 = none.
Veinscale: Frequency of the veins in object units; higher = finer veins.
Veinwarp: Domain-warp strength of the veins; higher = more twisted, swirly veins.
Crackamount: Fraction of voronoi edges shown as hairline cracks. 0 = none, 1 = all.
Crackscale: Cell size of the crack network in object units; higher = smaller cells.
Crackwidth: Width of the crack lines; higher = thicker cracks.
Envrot: Rotates the procedural studio environment around the vertical axis, 0-1 = one full turn.
Envint: Brightness multiplier of the procedural studio environment.
Modamount: Scales the modulation from in1 CHOP (band1 adds to Veinamount, beat adds to Crackamount). 0 = ignore in1.
Speed: Speed of preview and material animation. 1 = normal, 0 = frozen.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Exposure: Brightness multiplier applied to the preview render.
Bloom: Strength of the glow around bright areas in the preview. 0 = off.
Spinturns: Number of full preview rotations per animation cycle. 0 = no spin.
Tilt: Tilt of the preview torus knot in degrees.
Camdist: Preview camera distance in world units; larger = smaller objects.
Backdrop: Brightness of the preview background. 0 = black.
